72.. Items not on the posted agenda, to be presented and (if requested) referred to staff or placed on the agenda for action at a future meeting of the Board, or matters requiring immediate action.

75.. Opportunity for members of the public to address the Board on items of interest that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the board.

76.. Recommendation by Individual Supervisors that the Board adjourn the meeting in memory of deceased persons and/or commemoration of ceremonial occasions. Supervisor Antonovich made the following statement:

     "Thousand died during the terrorist attacks on September 11, 2001, when hijacked airliners crashed into and destroyed the Word Trade Center towers in New York City, damaged the Pentagon in Washington, D.C. and crashed in Pennsylvania.  Although the final count is not yet know, these innocent people did not die in vain, their memory will last through our own American spirit as our Nation brings all terrorists to justice."

PUBLIC HEARINGS     1 - 5 Moved by Yvonne B. Burke

Passed The Consent Agenda (Pass) Moved by Gloria Molina the Board took the following actions:

1.	Approved County Counsel's attached recommendations;

2.	Adopted the attached Ordinance No. 2001-0082 entitled, "An ordinance calling a special election to be held in the County of Los Angeles on March 5, 2002, and consolidating the special election with the primary election to be held on the same day." This ordinance would limit any person elected and qualified for the office of member of the Board of Supervisors, or for the office of Sheriff, District Attorney or Assessor, to three (3) consecutive terms commencing with a term of office which begins on or after December 2002; and 

3.	Adopted the attached Ordinance No. 2001-0083 entitled, "An ordinance calling a special election to be held in the County of Los Angeles on March 5, 2002, and consolidating the special election with the primary election to be held on the same day." This ordinance would limit any person elected and qualified for the office of member of the Board of Supervisors to three (3) consecutive terms commencing with a term of office which begins on or after December 2002.
